idea-plugin.name: Graylog Log Shipper
idea-plugin.description:
Streams the console output of your Run/Debug configurations to a Graylog GELF input (TCP, UDP or HTTP).
  • JSON log lines (Logstash/Logback, ECS, pino…) become Graylog fields: nested objects are flattened (http.status → http_status), strings containing JSON stay plain strings.
  • Plain-text logs: the level is detected and stack traces are grouped into one message.
  • Every message carries the project, run configuration, executor and session, plus your own static fields, so you can route it to a dedicated stream.

action.text: Envoyer les logs Run/Debug vers Graylog
action.description: Active ou coupe l'envoi de la sortie console des Run/Debug vers Graylog
